title: Comment notification opens the record page but not the comment; NavigationOverlay keeps a dead comments slot
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the f7-record area's dev while building #36225 (PR #36406, the side preview drops comments); noted out of scope, read from code, not measured. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

1. **A comment notification opens the record but not its comments.** Opening a comment notification lands on the full record page, and the reader must find and open the comment panel themselves to see the comment they were told about.
2. **Dead surface (cleanup).** `@object-ui/components` `NavigationOverlay` keeps an optional comments slot that the console no longer fills after #36406.

## To do

1. Measure item 1 on main. If it holds, open the comment panel (scrolled to the comment) when the record is opened from a comment notification.
2. Remove the unused comments slot from `NavigationOverlay` with its changeset (a published component prop is removed, so declare it truthfully), or say why it stays.

## Acceptance

- Opening a comment notification shows that comment without another click.

Blocked-by: #36406

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. Every user who follows a comment notification has to look for the comment.
